# Openstyle

Openstyle is a free, open source (MIT license) dictation app for macOS on
Apple silicon. Hold a key, talk, let go; it types clean text in the app you
use. Speech-to-text runs locally with MLX models, on your own server, or on a
cloud provider. There is no account, no cloud service, and no telemetry.

Website: https://maheidem.github.io/openstyle/
Source: https://github.com/Maheidem/openstyle
Downloads: https://github.com/Maheidem/openstyle/releases/latest

## What it does

- Hold your shortcut key, talk, let go. The text appears at your cursor in
  whatever app you were already typing in: editors, browsers, chat clients,
  terminals.
- Optional AI cleanup fixes grammar and punctuation and strips filler words.
- Meetings: Openstyle records your meetings, transcribes them after the call
  and writes a summary. It detects speakers.
- Import: transcribe audio files.
- Vocabulary: teach it your names and terms.
- Tone: set how the cleaned text sounds.
- Transcriptions: find anything you said.

## Where speech-to-text runs

You choose where your voice goes:

- Built into Openstyle: models run on your Mac with MLX (Parakeet, Qwen3-ASR,
  Whisper). Add more from Hugging Face. Audio stays on your Mac.
- Your own server: use oMLX, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server you
  run. Audio goes to that server.
- Cloud provider: use OpenAI, Groq, Deepgram, ElevenLabs and others with your
  own API key. Audio goes to that provider.

## Requirements

- macOS. The published builds are for Macs with Apple silicon (arm64) only.
- On first launch macOS asks for Microphone access, and for Accessibility and
  Input Monitoring access so the app can read the global hotkey and paste into
  other applications.

## Install

1. Download the latest .dmg (Apple Silicon) from the
   https://github.com/Maheidem/openstyle/releases page and drag it to
   Applications.
2. The build is ad-hoc signed, not notarized, so macOS will warn on first
   launch. Right-click the app and choose Open, or run:
   xattr -cr /Applications/Openstyle.app

## Performance

In tests on an idle Apple silicon Mac, Parakeet transcribed a 3-minute
recording in under a second. Measured October 2026 with Openstyle 2.10, warm
model.

## FAQ

Is Openstyle free?
Yes. Openstyle is free to download. The code is on GitHub under the MIT
license.

Does it work locally, without a cloud account?
Yes. Transcription can run entirely on your Mac with built-in MLX models.
There is no account, no cloud service, and no telemetry.

Which Macs are supported?
Macs with Apple silicon. The published builds are for arm64 only.

Does my audio leave my Mac?
Not with a built-in model. With your own server it goes to that server. With
a cloud provider it goes to that provider.

Can I use my own server?
Yes. Openstyle works with oMLX, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server you
run.

Does it take meeting notes?
Yes. It records meetings, transcribes them after the call, writes a summary,
and detects speakers.

How do updates work?
Openstyle checks for updates and downloads them in the background. You choose
when to restart.
